de.name: Playa de Santa María del Mar
de.text: Dieser beliebte Sandstrand in Cádiz schmiegt sich malerisch an die historische Altstadt. Dank der schützenden Wellenbrecher herrscht hier eine angenehme und sichere Badeatmosphäre. Besucher können sich auf entspannte Stunden im warmen Sand freuen und das Küstenflair genießen. Ein Besuch am späten Nachmittag bietet besonders schöne Ausblicke.

de.name: Playa de la Victoria
de.text: Als einer der besten Strände Europas erstreckt sich dieser breite Stadtstrand entlang der neuen Uferpromenade von Cádiz. Die weitläufige Kulisse zieht sowohl Einheimische als auch Urlauber in ihren Bann. Erwartungsgemäß bietet der Ort hervorragende Bedingungen für ausgedehnte Spaziergänge und ausgiebiges Sonnenbaden. Wer den Tag hier verbringt, sollte sich auch das Treiben auf der Promenade nicht entgehen lassen.

de.name: Tumbas Romanas

de.name: Playa de la Punta San Felipe
de.text: Versteckt in der Nähe der Mole San Felipe bietet dieser kleine Strandabschnitt in Cádiz einen authentischen Rückzugsort. Besonders bei Einheimischen wird die intime und ruhigere Atmosphäre dieser Küstenecke geschätzt. Es ist der perfekte Ort für eine kurze Erfrischung im Meer oder ein paar entspannte Stunden abseits des größten Trubels. Früh am Morgen findet man hier die meiste Ruhe.

de.name: Playa Puntales
de.text: Im ruhigen Viertel Puntales von Cádiz gelegen, öffnet sich dieser Stadtstrand mit einem herrlichen Blick auf die Bucht. Abseits der großen Touristenströme herrscht hier eine herrlich entspannte Stimmung. Neben ruhigen Momenten am Wasser kann man wunderbar den Blick über das weite Meer schweifen lassen. Wer abseits des Trubels Sonne tanken möchte, ist hier genau richtig.

A látogatók nyugodt napozásra és a part menti hangulat élvezetére számíthatnak. Érdemes a késő délutáni órákban érkezni a legszebb fényekért.

A terület kiváló lehetőségeket kínál hosszú sétákhoz és bőséges napozáshoz. Érdemes rászánni egy egész napot, hogy a parti sétány pezsgését is kiélvezhessük.

hu.text: A San Felipe móló közelében megbújó kis cádizi partszakasz igazán autentikus menedéket kínál. Ezt az intim és nyugodtabb tengerparti sarkot különösen a helyiek kedvelik. Tökéletes helyszín egy rövid, frissítő fürdőzésre vagy néhány csendes óra eltöltésére a legnagyobb nyüzsgéstől távol. A kora reggeli órákban a legbékésebb itt a hangulat.

hu.name: Playa Puntales

A vízparti kikapcsolódás mellett a látogatók élvezhetik a nyílt vízre nyíló lenyűgöző panorámát. Ideális választás azoknak, akik csendben szeretnének napozni.

ro.text: Această plajă populară cu nisip din Cádiz se află pitoresc în apropierea centrului istoric. Datorită digurilor protectoare, atmosfera de scăldat este deosebit de plăcută și sigură. Vizitatorii se pot bucura de ore de relaxare la soare și de aerul mării. O vizită după-amiaza târziu este ideală pentru a admira peisajul.

ro.name: Playa de la Victoria
ro.text: Considerată una dintre cele mai bune plaje din Europa, această întindere largă de coastă se desfășoară de-a lungul noii promenade din Cádiz. Spațiul generos atrage cu succes atât localnici, cât și vizitatori. Vă așteaptă condiții excelente pentru plimbări lungi la malul mării și plajă din plin. Pentru a profita la maximum de atmosferă, rezervați-vă o zi întreagă aici.

ro.text: Ascunsă în apropierea digului San Felipe, această mică plajă din Cádiz oferă un refugiu autentic. Această secțiune de coastă intimă și mai liniștită este apreciată în mod deosebit de localnici. Este locul perfect pentru o scurtă baie revigorantă în mare sau câteva ore de relaxare departe de agitația principală. Cel mai bine este să veniți dimineața devreme pentru a vă bucura de liniște.

ro.name: Playa Puntales

Departe de fluxurile mari de turiști, aici domnește o atmosferă minunat de relaxată. Pe lângă momentele de liniște la malul apei, vizitatorii pot admira priveliștea largă a mării. Este destinația ideală pentru cei care doresc să se bucure de soare în liniște.

en.text: Remains of the ancient Roman aqueduct of Cádiz located at Plaza de Asdrúbal.

en.name: Museo Taller Litográfico
en.text: A museum in Cádiz exhibiting historical lithographic printing machines and tools.

en.name: Antigua Fábrica de Salazones Romana
en.text: Archaeological site featuring the remains of a Roman fish-salting factory from the 1st century BC.

en.name: Casa de Iberoamérica
en.text: A cultural center housed in the former Royal Jail, hosting exhibitions on Ibero-American art.

en.name: Museo de Cádiz
en.text: The main museum of Cádiz, featuring significant archaeological finds from the Phoenician and Roman periods.

en.name: Museo de las Cortes de Cádiz
en.text: A museum dedicated to the history of the Spanish Constitution of 1812 and the siege of the city.

en.name: Casa del Obispo
en.text: An archaeological site near the cathedral featuring Phoenician, Roman, and medieval remains.

en.name: Baluarte de los Mártires
en.text: A historic bastion on the coast of Cádiz, currently used as a venue for events.

en.name: Baluarte de Capuchinos
en.text: Part of the former city fortifications of Cádiz overlooking the Atlantic Ocean.

en.name: Playa de Santa María del Mar
en.text: This popular sandy beach in Cádiz is picturesquely situated near the historic old town. Thanks to the protective breakwaters, the swimming environment remains consistently pleasant and secure. Visitors can look forward to relaxing hours in the sand while soaking up the coastal charm. Stopping by in the late afternoon offers especially lovely views.

en.name: Playa de la Victoria
en.text: Recognized as one of the best beaches in Europe, this broad urban shoreline stretches along the new promenade in Cádiz. The expansive coastal setting effortlessly draws in both locals and vacationers alike. You can expect excellent conditions for long, leisurely walks and ample sunbathing. Planning a full day here allows you to fully experience the vibrant promenade.

en.name: Baluarte de San Roque
en.text: A massive bastion located at the entrance to the old town, part of the city's defensive ring.

en.name: Hospital de Mujeres
en.text: An 18th-century Baroque building famous for its chapel containing a painting by El Greco.

en.name: Faro de San Sebastián
en.text: Built in 1913, this lighthouse is located on the San Sebastián island fortress in Cádiz.

en.name: Faro de las Puercas
en.text: This functional lighthouse marks the dangerous reefs at the entrance to the Bay of Cádiz.

en.name: Casa-Museo Pemán
en.text: The former home of writer José María Pemán now serves as a cultural center and museum.

en.name: Garita
en.text: A historic sentry box on the city walls, typical of the old defensive architecture of Cádiz.

en.name: Centro Andaluz de Arqueología Subacuática
en.text: Located in the former Balneario de la Palma, this center is dedicated to researching Andalusian underwater heritage.

en.name: Baluarte del Orejón
en.text: A historic bastion of the city fortifications, now used as a space for exhibitions and culture.

en.name: Catacumbas del Beaterio
en.text: Underground catacombs from the 17th century that once belonged to a religious brotherhood.

en.name: Columbario Romano
en.text: A Roman funerary site providing insight into the burial traditions of the ancient city of Gades.

en.name: Antigua Estación de Tren de Cádiz
en.text: The historic Neo-Mudéjar style railway station building now serves as an event space and market.

en.name: Centro Cultural Reina Sofía
en.text: A cultural center in Cádiz housed in a former barracks, hosting contemporary art exhibitions.

en.name: Isla Eco
en.text: A small museum in Cádiz focusing on ecological themes and the local marine environment.

en.name: Antiguas murallas y contrafuertes de Cádiz
en.text: Historical remains of the old city walls and buttresses that once protected Cádiz from attacks.

en.name: Tumba fenopúnica
en.text: An important archaeological site in Cádiz displaying the remains of a Phoenician-Punic tomb.

en.name: Casa Romana de Varela
en.text: The archaeological remains of a Roman house discovered in the Varela district of Cádiz.

en.name: Tumbas Romanas
en.text: An ancient necropolis in Cádiz featuring various Roman tombs from the period of Roman rule.

en.name: Antiguas Murallas de Cádiz
en.text: Part of the massive historical fortifications that surround the historic center of Cádiz.

en.name: Playa de la Punta San Felipe
en.text: Tucked away near the San Felipe mole, this small beach section in Cádiz serves as an authentic coastal retreat. The intimate and somewhat quieter atmosphere of this spot is particularly favored by locals. It makes a perfect destination for a quick, refreshing dip or a few hours of relaxation away from the main crowds. Arriving early in the morning guarantees the most peaceful experience.

en.name: Playa Puntales
en.text: Located in the quiet Puntales district of Cádiz, this urban beach opens up with magnificent views across the bay. Away from the heavy tourist traffic, the shoreline maintains a wonderfully relaxed and easygoing mood. Visitors can enjoy peaceful moments by the water while taking in the expansive maritime scenery. This is the ideal spot if you want to soak up the sun without the usual crowds.

en.name: Parque Carlos III
en.text: A scenic public park and promenade along the northern coastline of Cadiz.

en.name: Casa de las Cadenas
en.text: A significant 17th-century baroque manor house known for its marble columns.

en.name: Casa de las Cinco Torres
en.text: A complex of five historical merchant houses in Cadiz featuring characteristic watchtowers.

en.name: Casa del Almirante
en.text: A grand baroque mansion built in the 17th century for Admiral Diego de Barrios.

en.name: Casa Lasquetty
en.text: An 18th-century manor house in Cadiz, representative of the city's merchant golden age.

en.name: Monumento a Cayetano del Toro
en.text: A monument dedicated to the influential 19th-century doctor and former mayor of Cadiz.

en.name: Escultura ecuestre de Simón Bolivar
en.text: An equestrian statue of Simón Bolívar located in Cádiz, honoring the South American liberator.

en.name: El Pirulí
en.text: A distinctive communications tower in Cádiz, often referred to as Torre Tavira II.

en.name: Piscina Municipal de Astilleros
en.text: The Astilleros municipal swimming pool in Cádiz offers public facilities for swimming and fitness.

en.name: Playa de la Cortadura
en.text: The longest beach in Cádiz, known for its extensive dune system and natural environment.

descriptionAdvanced.de: Cádiz, eine der ältesten kontinuierlich besiedelten Städte Westeuropas, liegt malerisch auf einer schmalen Halbinsel, die fast vollständig vom Atlantik umschlossen ist. Diese einzigartige geografische Lage verleiht der Stadt ihr charakteristisches, lichtdurchflutetes maritimes Flair und brachte ihr den Beinamen 'Tacita de Plata' (Silbertässchen) ein. Das Herz der historischen Altstadt bildet die majestätische, goldgekuppelte Kathedrale Nueva, die Architekturstile vom Barock bis zum Neoklassizismus vereint. Entlang der alten Festungsmauern und der lebhaften Uferpromenaden lassen sich jahrtausendealte Spuren der Phönizier, Römer und Mauren entdecken. Weltbekannt ist Cádiz zudem für seinen humorvollen, satirischen Karneval, der die Straßen alljährlich in ein farbenfrohes, singendes Fest verwandelt.
descriptionAdvanced.hu: Cádiz, Nyugat-Európa egyik legrégebbi, folyamatosan lakott városa festői környezetben, egy keskeny, az Atlanti-óceán által szinte teljesen körülölelt félszigeten fekszik. Ez az egyedülálló földrajzi elhelyezkedés adja a város jellegzetes, fényárban úszó tengerparti hangulatát, ami a 'Tacita de Plata' (Ezüstcsésze) becenevet is hozta számára. A történelmi óváros szívét a fenséges, aranykupolás Nueva katedrális alkotja, amely a barokktól a neoklasszicizmusig számos építészeti stílust ötvöz. A régi erődítményfalak és a nyüzsgő parti sétányok mentén a föníciaiak, rómaiak és mórok évezredes nyomait fedezhetjük fel. Cádiz világszerte ismert továbbá humoros, szatirikus karneváljáról, amely minden évben színes, éneklő ünneppé varázsolja az utcákat.
descriptionAdvanced.ro: Cádiz, unul dintre cele mai vechi orașe locuite continuu din Europa de Vest, este situat pitoresc pe o peninsulă îngustă înconjurată aproape în întregime de Oceanul Atlantic. Această locație geografică unică conferă orașului flerul său maritim caracteristic, plin de lumină, și i-a adus supranumele de 'Tacita de Plata' (Ceșcuța de argint). Inima centrului istoric este maiestuoasa Catedrală Nueva, cu cupola sa aurie, care combină stiluri arhitecturale de la baroc la neoclasicism. De-a lungul vechilor ziduri ale fortăreței și a promenadelor pline de viață se pot descoperi urme milenare ale fenicienilor, romanilor și maurilor. De asemenea, Cádiz este renumit în întreaga lume pentru carnavalul său umoristic și satiric, care transformă străzile într-un festival colorat și cântător în fiecare an.
descriptionAdvanced.en: Cádiz, one of the oldest continuously inhabited cities in Western Europe, is picturesquely situated on a narrow peninsula almost entirely surrounded by the Atlantic Ocean. This unique geographical location gives the city its characteristic, light-flooded maritime flair and earned it the nickname 'Tacita de Plata' (Little Silver Cup). The heart of the historic old town is the majestic, golden-domed Cathedral Nueva, combining architectural styles from Baroque to Neoclassicism. Along the old fortress walls and bustling waterfront promenades, one can discover millennial traces of the Phoenicians, Romans, and Moors. Cádiz is also world-renowned for its humorous, satirical carnival, which transforms the streets into a colorful, singing festival every year.
descriptionAdvanced.es: Cádiz, una de las ciudades continuamente pobladas más antiguas de Europa Occidental, se encuentra pintorescamente en una estrecha península casi totalmente rodeada por el Atlántico. Esta ubicación geográfica única confiere a la ciudad su aire marítimo característico y bañado por la luz, lo que le valió el apodo de 'Tacita de Plata'. El corazón del casco antiguo lo forma la majestuosa catedral Nueva, con su cúpula dorada, que aúna estilos desde el barroco al neoclásico. A lo largo de las antiguas murallas y los animados paseos marítimos se pueden descubrir huellas milenarias de fenicios, romanos y musulmanes. Cádiz es mundialmente famosa por su carnaval humorístico y satírico, que transforma las calles cada año en una fiesta colorida y cantada.
descriptionAdvanced.pt: Cádis, uma das cidades continuamente habitadas mais antigas da Europa Ocidental, situa-se pitorescamente numa estreita península quase totalmente rodeada pelo Atlântico. Esta localização geográfica única confere à cidade o seu ar marítimo característico e banhado pela luz, o que lhe valeu a alcunha de 'Tacita de Plata' (Chávena de Prata). O coração do centro histórico é formado pela majestosa catedral Nova, com a sua cúpula dourada, que une estilos desde o barroco ao neoclássico. Ao longo das antigas muralhas e dos animados passeios marítimos, podem-se descobrir vestígios milenares de fenícios, romanos e muçulmanos. Cádis é mundialmente famosa pelo seu carnaval humorístico e satírico, que transforma as ruas todos os anos numa festa colorida e cantada.
descriptionAdvanced.fr: Cadix, l'une des villes continuellement peuplées les plus anciennes d'Europe occidentale, est située de façon pittoresque sur une étroite péninsule presque entièrement entourée par l'Atlantique. Cette situation géographique unique confère à la ville son air maritime caractéristique et baigné de lumière, ce qui lui a valu le surnom de 'Tacita de Plata' (Petite tasse d'argent). Le cœur de la vieille ville est formé par la majestueuse nouvelle cathédrale, avec son dôme doré, qui allie des styles allant du baroque au néoclassique. Le long des anciens remparts et des promenades animées, on peut découvrir des traces millénaires des Phéniciens, des Romains et des musulmans. Cadix est mondialement connue pour son carnaval humoristique et satirique, qui transforme chaque année les rues en une fête colorée et chantante.

de: Cádiz wurde um 1100 v. Chr. von den Phöniziern unter dem Namen 'Gadir' gegründet.
Im Jahr 1812 wurde in Cádiz die erste liberale Verfassung Spaniens (La Pepa) verabschiedet.
Der Torre Tavira war im 18. Jahrhundert der offizielle Wachturm des Hafens und beherbergt heute eine Camera Obscura.
Die Brücke Puente de la Constitución de 1812 ist mit 5 Kilometern Länge eine der beeindruckendsten in Europa.
Der Stadtstrand Playa de la Caleta ist berühmt für seine malerischen Sonnenuntergänge und Filmauftritte.
Der Hafen von Cádiz genoss im 18. Jahrhundert das spanische Monopol für den Handel mit Amerika.
es: Cádiz fue fundada por los fenicios con el nombre de 'Gadir'.
En 1812 se aprobó en Cádiz la primera constitución liberal española ('La Pepa').
La Torre Tavira era la torre oficial de vigilancia del puerto en el siglo XVIII.
El Puente de la Constitución de 1812 es uno de los más impresionantes de Europa.
La playa de La Caleta es famosa por sus puestas de sol.
El puerto de Cádiz gozó del monopolio español del comercio con América en el siglo XVIII.
pt: Cádis foi fundada pelos fenícios com o nome de 'Gadir'.
Em 1812 foi aprovada em Cádis a primeira constituição liberal espanhola ('La Pepa').
A Torre Tavira era a torre oficial de vigilância do porto no século XVIII.
A Ponte da Constituição de 1812 é uma das mais impressionantes da Europa.
A praia da La Caleta é famosa pelos seus pores do sol.
O porto de Cádis gozou do monopólio espanhol do comércio com a América no século XVIII.
fr: Cadix a été fondée par les Phéniciens sous le nom de 'Gadir'.
En 1812, la première constitution libérale espagnole ('La Pepa') a été approuvée à Cadix.
La Torre Tavira était la tour de guet officielle du port au XVIIIe siècle.
Le pont de la Constitución de 1812 est l'un des plus impressionnants d'Europe.
La plage de La Caleta est célèbre pour ses couchers de soleil.
Le port de Cadix a bénéficié du monopole espagnol du commerce avec l'Amérique au XVIIIe siècle.
